description: The shell app this node names at home or on its face (at, home or face): with no name it answers {ok, status, name}, the one named, app if none is set; with a name it names that app and answers the same. Refused 400 bad-place when at is neither home nor face, and 400 not-a-shell when there is no such app or its own json does not say it is a shell.
